verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's LLC overview page lists 'An EIN, which is used to file taxes, open bank accounts, and build your staff' among the items included with formation, so the platform claims to obtain an EIN for founders. The support rests on that single thin line item. missing for 10: how the EIN filing works, which packages or tiers include it, confirmation that it applies to corporations as well as LLCs, turnaround time, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
